generation.scope: On the mixed-characteristic three-adic annulus of ordinary rank-fifteen windows with 0<v(y)<3v(x) and 5v(y)<=6v(3), all four starts are standard Koszul, left and right AS-regular and free of rank 256 over the four central quartics. Two-sided multiplication tables reach the target four-cut in every degree through vanishing at thirteen, using fifteen H-digits over F3(z) and restarting from the integral length-six lattices at five digits.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed reduction of the free length-six lattices, the map to the truncated valuation ring, lifting of the four central elements, both multiplication maps, precision losses, the free-module Hilbert comparison, and the two-sided Koszul argument.

mathematical_computation.scope: Fifteen H-digits over F3(z), four starts and four characters. Two-sided overlap saturations from degrees six through thirteen lose 2,2,0,2,0,0,0,0 digits. All denominators and pivots are units at z^2+z+2.

open_mathematics: Remove the annulus bound 5v(y)<=6v(3) on the variable-trace disk.
